subject: Security prioritization: SOC 2 / retention / pen-test evidence — recap & action plan
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elena Moreno <elena.moreno@vaultbank.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Security prioritization: SOC 2 / retention / pen-test evidence — recap & action plan

Hi Elena — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Summary of pain & goals we captured
- Audit log retention: VaultBank needs 7 years of immutable audit logs for payment reconciliation workflows; current plans default to 13 months.
- SOC 2 status: you’re finalizing a Type II report for controls over data custody (targeted Q4). Need to understand if there will be any scope exclusions for inference telemetry.
- Pen test evidence: your procurement requires vulnerability scan / pentest artifacts (report + remediation timeline) for the model runtime.
- DPA / retention terms: legal needs template edits for data retention and audit access (especially around third-party model cache and KV stores).

Primary goals
1) Determine evidence set Redwood must supply to satisfy VaultBank procurement (SOC2 artifacts, pen-test, audit log retention config).
2) Align on a DPA addendum for retention windows and allowed telemetry.
3) Get a narrow POC scope (sandbox + 100k monthly tokens) with an acceptance checklist we can meet within 6–8 weeks.

Action items (owners & suggested dates)
- Elena / VaultBank: send any SOC 2 bridge notes or expected control exclusions; share procurement checklist (due: Tue 25 Jul).
- Redwood (Sofia): provide a concise evidence pack template (SOC2 artifacts we can share, redaction guidance) + a proposed retention mapping doc (due: Wed 26 Jul). Attachment: SOC2-request-template.pdf (draft).
- Redwood (Monica): technical notes on how we can configure immutable audit logs and retention policies in the Private deployment (deliverable: retention-matrix-draft.xlsx, due: Fri 28 Jul).
- Viva (CC’d): engineering feasibility check on pen-test report availability and timeline (Vivek to confirm).

Next calls
- Tech deep dive (logs & retention): propose Thu 27 Jul, 11am PT (30m) — please confirm attendees.
- Contract sync (legal + procurement): propose Tue 1 Aug, 9am PT.

Notes on evidence sharing
- We can supply redacted SOC 2 Type II PDFs and a controls mapping. Anything requiring signatures (attestations) we’ll route through your procurement security portal.
- For pen-test, we typically provide a summary and remediation verification; full raw findings are gated behind an NDA/procurement agreement.

If that matches your read, I’ll circulate the evidence template + retention matrix and lock the tech deep dive.

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0123
Attachment: SOC2-request-template.pdf (pdf)
From: Elena Moreno <elena.moreno@vaultbank.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: security@vaultbank.com
Date: Mon, 24 Jul 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security prioritization: SOC 2 / retention / pen-test evidence — recap & action plan

Sofia — thanks for the clear recap. Short answers and a couple of attachments from our side: procurement-checklist.pdf (see item 6 for pen-test requirement) and our DPA redline template.

Quick clarifications:
- SOC 2: we expect the Type II cover for production telemetry; if you have any controls scoped out (e.g., model provider telemetry), flag them now.
- Retention: 7 years immutable for audit logs tied to payment flows, 1 year for general inference telemetry unless otherwise required by law.
- Pen-test: we need evidence of third-party pen-test results (last 12 months) or a remediation roadmap and a confirmed date for a pen test in our environment.

We can join Tech deep dive Thu 27 Jul 11am PT — I’ll invite our infra/security lead (Martin Reyes) to that call. We’ll target internal procurement approval by mid-August if the evidence set is complete.

Elena
Elena Moreno
Head of Vendor Risk | VaultBank
elena.moreno@vaultbank.com
Attachment: procurement-checklist.pdf (pdf); VaultBank-DPA-redline.docx (docx)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elena Moreno <elena.moreno@vaultbank.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security prioritization: SOC 2 / retention / pen-test evidence — recap & action plan

Thanks Elena — that’s helpful and aligned. Per your procurement checklist we’ll assemble the following and share by Wed 26 Jul: 
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II (if available) + controls mapping for telemetry and cache handling
- Retention mapping (immutable logs for payment flows vs. general telemetry) — see retention-matrix-draft.xlsx (attached)
- Pen-test status note: if we don’t have a 3rd-party pen-test in the last 12 months for the Private runtime, we’ll propose a pen-test window (we can run in your sandbox environment; typical lead time 3–4 weeks) and a remediation verification plan.

Vivek — can you confirm feasibility on: immutable audit log configuration in Private deployments (S3 WORM or similar), and an estimate on executing a pen-test in their sandbox (earliest feasible dates)?

Action items update:
- Redwood (Sofia): send SOC2 redaction checklist + retention mapping (Wed 26 Jul).
- Redwood (Monica): finalized retention matrix + export examples (Wed 26 Jul).
- Redwood (Vivek): feasibility + earliest windows for pen-test (reply below).

I’ll also drop a link to a short playbook that explains how we limit KV/cache telemetry in Private deployments — will be in the shared Drive link.

Best — Sofia
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Elena Moreno <elena.moreno@vaultbank.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security prioritization: SOC 2 / retention / pen-test evidence — recap & action plan

On Tue, Jul 25, 2028 at 10:42 AM Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com> wrote:
> Vivek — can you confirm feasibility on: immutable audit log configuration in Private deployments (S3 WORM or similar), and an estimate on executing a pen-test in their sandbox (earliest feasible dates)?

Quick feasibility notes:
- Immutable logs: yes — Private deployment supports WORM retention via object-lock on S3-compatible buckets. We can map events to the payment flow namespace and apply a 7-year retention policy. Export tooling will provide daily signed manifests for audit.
- Pen-test: we don’t have a recent third-party pen-test that specifically targeted VaultBank’s scenario. Earliest realistic window for an external pen-test in their sandbox is Aug 14–25 (3rd party availability + prep). Internal verification testing can be run earlier (week of Aug 6) to surface obvious issues.
- Deliverables: remediation tracker (simple CSV) + verification snapshot (screenshot / log hashes) typically within 5 business days after a pen-test.

I’ll prep a short tech appendix and attach it to the retention matrix Sofia is finalizing.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Principal Engineer, Platform | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
